publicIdle.method: Five application ping/pong samples in one temporary empty waiting room; room left immediately. No public combat load test.
publicIdle.inference: The reported 103–107 ms is reproducible without simulation load. Route/distance is not isolated by this test.

localLoadedSample.method: One local simulation snapshot after 50 ticks, 100 encodes; compression at the server level 1 setting. Results depend on scene and hardware; not a measured public loaded RTT improvement.
